description: Divide waist by height to get your waist-to-height ratio and health category — aim for under 0.5.

faqs.a: Measure around your waist at the midpoint between your lowest rib and hip bone, after breathing out normally.
faqs.q: Where do I measure my waist?

faqs.a: Keep your waist under half your height — a ratio below 0.5 is the widely used healthy cutoff.
Studies link it more closely to cardiometabolic risk than BMI alone, since it captures abdominal fat.

howto: Measure your waist in cm at the midpoint between ribs and hips.
Read your ratio and risk category.
title: Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator
